row.proto: uint64_t Ent_EntrantsDocument_ReplaceEntrantIdentity(void *doc, void *old_id, void *new_id, uint8_t *opt_entrant_id, uint32_t *opt_vehicle_cust, uint32_t *opt_driver_cust, uint16_t car_number)
row.notes: Swaps the identity of an entrant in the document's EntrantRecord vector (+0x08..+0x10). No-op if old and new identity match. Otherwise posts EntrantsDocumentOpened, sets busy flag +0x20, finds the record matching old_id; if another record already holds new_id it is given old_id (swap). Writes new name_block, ordinal_flags, optional id_lo/id_hi, driver_customisation, vehicle_customisation and car_number (param used only if >0xff), posts two bus messages (0x145790a60, 0x14568fc70 with old/new id and swapped flag), then EntrantsDocumentClosed. Good hook for drop-in/player swap.
